title: Mixed Event — Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show! — Episode1 A New Year's Show With Everyone

meta.Event: Happy New Year! Lion Dance Robot's New Year's Show!
meta.Episode: Episode1 — A New Year's Show With Everyone
meta.Event Outline: After successfully wrapping up their ambassadorial performances, Wonderlands×Showtime is preparing to put on a New Year's show at the new and improved Wonder Stage. Unfortunately, Lion Dance Robot seems to be feeling a bit under the weather...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “After ten years of toil, I, Tsukasanosuke Tenma, have at long last discovered the greatest treasure under the sun!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“However, this box is enormous...
If it is filled with gold, then I would not have to work another day as long as I live.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Heh heh heh. So, let us see what is inside!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Ah, such a heavenly light...!
This must be a treasure of immeasurable wealth!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Oh, my eyes... I was afraid that I had gone blind... Hm?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“How is this possible?!
All I hear is him chomping, but I can understand exactly what he is trying to say...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Huh?! 'I am a deity'...?!
What are you saying...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Yes, this shrine does indeed have a long history... But to think that you are its patron deity!”

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line:
“CHOMP, CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP.
CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Uh... 'It is understandable that you do not believe me'...? An odd and boastful creature you are...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Gwah...!
His thoughts keep penetrating my head...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What?!
'I shall grant you a wish if you are able to make the people of this land smile'...?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “A-Anything...? Including gold, money and giant castles...?!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Miku, Len, just like we practiced! Get ready to raise the castle backdrop on three!
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Wh-What?! A castle just appeared in the distance?! You truly are a deity...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Then, I know!
To make my dream of having a castle of my own a reality, I shall make the people of this land smile...”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And so, Tsukasanosuke embarked on a journey with the Lion Dance Deity to perform for people all across Japan♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Woof woof woof!
It's great to see so many people visiting the shrine today♪”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “But this Lion-Dog's starting to get bored of being stuck here working. It'd be great to go out for a walk and go somewhere else for a change...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Come one, come all!
All are welcome to see the traveling performer!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Hm? Is he a traveling performer?
Does that mean he's gonna do something for all of us?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“That sounds fun!
Oh, I know! I should ask to see if I can join him...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I am so glad that I was born a Snake Deity. All these humans bring me offerings without me having to lift a finger.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“However, they are all so scared of me that they refuse to stay to listen to my singing...
*Sigh*”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “See the traveling performer's amazing show! Woof woof! Huh...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Hey, Tsukasanosuke!
I see a Snake Deity over there!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“A Snake Deity?!
That is quite a rare find... Hm...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Hehehe... If she were to join us, our performance should attract just that much more attention! Lion-Dog, we must capture her!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Oh, what is this?
I exited the shrine to see what was going on with the village...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Come one, come all!
See the traveling performer's amazing show!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “S-Singing is all I promised to do...!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Well, it is nice to see a troupe like this for a change.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “It may actually be worth this shapeshifting fox's time to join in on the festivities.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Let us see how it goes...
Hello there, traveling performer. Do you have a moment?”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The Lion Dance Deity led the human, Lion-Dog, Snake and Fox as they set out to put smiles on the faces of people all across Japan, from north to south, by performing a show that they had never seen before.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Before they knew it, ten years had passed, and they were able to put on a New Year's performance that made the entire audience smile from ear to ear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah! You can say that again!
I, Tsukasanosuke, am the most dashing man in all of Japan after all!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Now, my divine friend!
I believe it is time for you to grant me my wish!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“First, my castle!
Naturally, I shall call it, Tenma Castle!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“What...?
'Despite being a deity, my powers waned significantly while I was sealed away, so I am limited to producing projections of castles'...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Wh-What is the meaning of this...?!
I had your word. It is why I worked so hard all these years! Was it all a lie?!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
Were these past ten years all for naught...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Please cheer up, Tsukasanosuke!
Your castle... I can't really do anything about that...”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “But I had a lot of fun these past ten years thanks to you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“So what if you did...?
You had fun. Good for you. But I have nothing to show for my efforts...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I have been alive for 200 years, but these past ten years have definitely been the most fun...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “All good things eventually wither away. Castles are no exception. However, the time we spent together... That will likely never fade.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Yes, I agree.
I too have been alive for quite some time...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “But I would not trade seeing people all across Japan smile for any amount of gold.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Tsukasanosuke, you may not have been rewarded with a physical treasure. However, to those who you've made smile, you mean everything to them...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“And those smiles we saw...
That became our treasure.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Their smiles are our treasure...?
I see...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “And yet, we still have one person left who is not smiling... Well, a deity, not a person...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“...
I apologize for calling you a liar, my friend.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I could not have attained this treasure on my own. You were the one who made it possible.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “So, thank you for these past ten years.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “I see. I do not fully understand what is happening, but by bringing back the smiles on everyone's faces, you seem to have regained your powers...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“So much power...!
More power than even the Great Snake Deity!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“W-Wait! A real castle...?!
My wish came true...?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“That's great, Tsukasanosuke!
You finally got the castle you wanted!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “How would you all feel about using this place as a theatre for our performances...?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “We can gather people here to do performances for them, and even perform outside from time to time... Would that not be a fun way to put a smile on the faces of the people of this land?”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Yeah! I wanna do that!
Let's keep doing shows together!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Whoa!
Give me a little warning before throwing yourselves at me like that! Hahaha...!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And so, Tsukasanosuke and his merry group of friends continued to make everybody all across the land smile. The end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent dress rehearsal...!
And a wonderful New Year's spectacle!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah!
Of course it is!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We plan to have some members of the audience participate during the day of, so things should become even more fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The audience?! That does sound like fun♪ Break a leg, you guys☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Still, it's been pretty long since we last properly did a show at the Wonder Stage...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it has!
As sad as it was to hear that we wouldn't be doing any more ambassadorial performances...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make everyone who comes to visit the Wonder Stage smile from ear to ear!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm? Is everything okay, Tsukasa...?
You look like you have something on your mind...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Me?
No, I'm okay. It's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Wh-What the...?
Why is smoke coming out of Lion Dance Robot all of a sudden...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, he may be overheating because he had to move around quite a lot just now... Which means he might...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Waaah!
Wh-Why's he chasing after me again?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't worry. I made it so his fans automatically cool him while he runs around. He isn't malfunctioning, so he should settle down in a moment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, so I have to keep running until he does?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, they're playing tag♪
We wanna join!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's jump right into it!
